method: Opened all 90 images in the last third of the sorted strip list (strip_046 to strip_133, including both files numbered 116 and 117) with the Read tool, one at a time. Suspect spots were re-checked on exact frames pulled with ffmpeg select=eq(n,FRAME) into a private scratch folder: hair top at 105.1 and 109.6 to 111.3, the app-recording chip between 100.8 and 101.6, the burned AI label at 115.3, the dark block at 136.1, a one-frame mouth change at 174.27 (every frame 174.24 to 175.21 plus the picture EDL and word timings), the text-plate windows at 92 to 98 and 191 to 197, the phone window at 183 to 191, and the last frames. Flash returns were matched to the flashes and flash_dropped lists in beats.json. No pair_* images fall in this share.
